events.title: Battle of Waterloo
events.description: Napoleon Bonaparte was decisively defeated near Waterloo in present-day Belgium by the Seventh Coalition, led by the Duke of Wellington and Prussian Field Marshal Gebhard von Blücher.
events.significance: The defeat ended Napoleon's rule as Emperor of the French after his Hundred Days return, closing the Napoleonic Wars and reshaping the European balance of power for decades.

events.title: United States Declares War on Britain
events.description: President James Madison signed the declaration of war passed by Congress, beginning the War of 1812 against the United Kingdom over trade restrictions, impressment of American sailors, and British support for Native American resistance.
events.significance: It was the first time the United States formally declared war on another nation, and the conflict strengthened American national identity and sovereignty.

events.title: Churchill's 'Finest Hour' Speech and De Gaulle's Appeal
events.description: Winston Churchill delivered his 'This was their finest hour' speech to the House of Commons as France collapsed. The same day, Charles de Gaulle broadcast his Appeal of 18 June from London via the BBC, urging the French to continue resisting Germany.
events.significance: Both addresses galvanized Allied resolve during World War II, and de Gaulle's appeal marked the beginning of the Free French movement.

events.title: Sally Ride Becomes First American Woman in Space
events.description: Astronaut Sally Ride launched aboard the Space Shuttle Challenger on mission STS-7, serving as a mission specialist.
events.significance: Her flight broke a major barrier in space exploration and inspired generations of women to pursue careers in science, technology, engineering, and mathematics.

events.title: Birth of Paul McCartney
events.description: Paul McCartney, the English singer-songwriter and bassist, was born in Liverpool, England.
events.significance: As a co-founder of The Beatles and a prolific solo artist, McCartney became one of the most influential and commercially successful musicians in history.
